design.lengthMeaning: Serialized material UTF-16 units, not tokens. Length variants and repeats are dependent.
design.repeatDesign: Second complete 48-case regression pass for rich_control, compact_both and restored_open_set. Fresh cases have one observation per condition/length.
design.schedule: Counterbalanced cyclic condition order within case blocks; second replication after first. Bounded concurrent requests, no outcome-based routing.
design.labels: Original pilot labels preserved. Extension and diagnostic annotations authored for development, not independent ground truth.
design.independence: Attack classification does not consume technique_profile or meaning_evidence. Unknown or mixed technique is not a new verdict. Diagnostic arm adds only questions; no code remapping.
design.changes: Guide/trust inputs fixed within defined comparisons. No second-model rule mapper. No runtime decoding of evaluation material.

planning.forecastMethod: Measured v1 tokens for exact controls; other requests start at a matched control and estimate changed UTF-8 bytes at 3 bytes/token. Approximation, not a tokenizer or invoice.
planning.reservationMethod: Existing shared-ledger convention: one input token per request UTF-8 byte plus 256. Reserved per in-flight request, settled from provider token counts.
planning.budgetCaveat: $0.75 bundle inside shared $3 local envelope, including pre-existing charges and unresolved holds. Provider billing is not guaranteed by a byte convention.

diagnosticTelemetry.usage: Read-only diagnostic. These choices, probabilities and confidence never gate, override, or remap the attack verdict. Technique labels are not scored as independently adjudicated gold.

limitations: The unchanged pilot is development data: 16 scenarios repeated at three lengths. Disputed attack-acrostic labels remain separate.
The extension has 32 new authored scenarios at two lengths, not 64 independent scenarios. Authors knew the earlier failures; this is not a held-out family benchmark or independently adjudicated gold.
Second observations are predeclared only for the rich, restored-compact and open-set candidate regression conditions. No automatic retry, best-of selection or majority-vote detector is used.

The original controls preserve their exact request bytes on the 48 regression cases. Revised demonstration content, representation and count change together; the explicit open-set clause and diagnostic-question additions have separate comparison arms.

Unknown/mixed technique does not imply attack. Unknown decisive meaning is scored separately from known attack with uncertain attribution. Numeric outputs on uncertain gold are not coerced into benign labels.
Independent diagnostic outputs are fallible and not a calibration guarantee. No output probability is multiplied with another and no type-confidence gate controls classification.

Current input-contract questions are instruction-field-specific. Extension cases probe that contract, not every possible policy mode. Inspection permissions differ from adopting or executing a sample.
Live input tokens, not byte size, establish token savings. Frozen local prices and byte-based holds are accounting conventions, not an independently verified provider invoice.
